inputs.name: hidden_states_1
inputs.means: target-image latents (decode, first chunk) or hidden states (later chunks)

inputs.name: modulation
inputs.means: Embed output 2: per-block scales and gates, from the sampled t (decode) or t=0 (prefix)

inputs.name: temb
inputs.means: Embed output 1: the timestep embedding the final AdaLayerNorm reads

inputs.name: cos
inputs.means: real part of the 3-axis RoPE table for this function's token range

inputs.name: sin
inputs.means: imaginary part of the same table, with the rotation's pair-swap sign folded in (qwen_layout.fold_rope_sign) — feeding the raw imaginary part instead rotates every query and key the wrong way

inputs.name: cache_k_1
inputs.means: prefix keys for this chunk's layers, post-norm and post-RoPE

inputs.name: cache_v_1
inputs.means: prefix values for this chunk's layers

inputs.name: bias
inputs.means: additive attention mask: 0 where attendable, -1e4 at padded prompt positions
